video_title: How Much Does It Hurt the Knicks If Mitchell Robinson Can’t Play?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the impact of Mitchell Robinson's injury
quotes.excerpt: That shit go impact. Like people like, oh yeah, all he do is grab rebounds and I'm sitting up here saying, yeah.

text_blocks.text: Yeah, and then he clobbered as he's trying to kick him out and yeah, like what? All he do is grab rebounds, block shots and catch lobs. You don't think that's going to affect the finger?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the increased pressure on Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: Now it puts a lot of more pressure on Karl-Anthony Towns, not to go out there and put monster numbers up.
quotes.quote: Now it puts a lot of more pressure on Karl-Anthony Towns, not to go out there and put monster numbers up, but to continue to play without picking up dumbass fouls. Now all of a sudden that window of him, I don't know how much he averages, but he probably averages about 32 minutes a game or somewhere around there, that might be 40 minutes a game.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the Knicks' potential and Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: Your Jalen Brunson's been looks like one of the best players in the world right now.
quotes.quote: I can sell you a lot of words, right? You just got to look at how your team's performed. Your Jalen Brunson's been looks like one of the best players in the world right now. His team looks elite. There's nothing else to say. They got a chance. They there. They're four wins away.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the defensive threat of the small-ball lineup
quotes.excerpt: That small ball lineup with OG Anunoby at the five scares the living shit out of me.
quotes.quote: Even if big Mitch is not healthy and they can't play him, that small ball lineup with OG Anunoby at the five scares the living shit out of me. I watched it. I watched it. I mean, you can't run it for a long period of time, but if you can squeeze about 10 to 12 minutes out of that lineup, offensively that is a problem. You just have to gang rebound, but you look at their rebounders though like Josh Hart, he's one of the best rebounding wing guards that we've ever seen in the history of the game.
